name: Ghassulian
alt: Late Chalcolithic of the Southern Levant

predecessors.name: Pottery Neolithic Levant
predecessors.text: "today's Jordan, Israel and Palestinian territories": Teleilat el-Ghassul "in the eastern Jordan Valley near the northern edge of the Dead Sea", "especially in the region of Beersheba", settlements…

ledger.x: 4400 BCE: the Ghassulian Chalcolithic, with its copper hoards and underground dwellings, succeeds the Wadi Rabah.
3800 BCE: the Ghassulian ends; the Early Bronze Age I of Canaan follows, which no dossier draws.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture: a band along the Jordan and radii around Beersheba, Teleilat Ghassul and the coastal plain, never a frontier.
